summary: REQ-1 is largely implemented: the Google Sheets URL was moved to an admin-only backend method and the frontend only fetches/displays it for admins on the Conceptmachine page. REQ-2/REQ-3 appear mostly implemented (new admin list endpoint + hook + ProfilePage integration), but the backend admin list implementation seems to omit admins who do not have a saved profile, which may violate the requirement to list the current set of admins.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend admin-only query returns the current set of admin principals (at minimum principals), including admins even if they have no saved profile.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend implementation of getAllAdmins() derives admins only by filtering userProfiles.entries(), which will exclude any admin principals that exist in access control state but do not have an entry in userProfiles.
evidence: backend/main.mo (getAllAdmins filters userProfiles.entries() and maps profiles to AdminInfo)
